explanation.headline: FDA's records show the methylprednisolone acetate shortage has been listed since 2021-12-15 and remains current as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA first posted the methylprednisolone acetate injection shortage on 2021-12-15 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
Multiple manufacturers including Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Eugia US LLC, Par Health USA LLC, Pfizer Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals are listed with current shortage status.
Eugia US LLC updated 2026-10-19 with recovery TBD and advises checking wholesalers for inventory.
Pfizer Inc. updated 2026-09-21 and Sagent Pharmaceuticals updated 2026-10-08, both remain current.
The rule-based transfer option ranked 1 moves 27 units from Corvale General (23 days on hand) to Corvale Lakeside (7 days on hand) which would reach 14 days.

rejected.text: The most recent FDA update for Amneal Pharmaceuticals was 2026-10-06 with estimated recovery late October 2026/November 2026.
rejected.reason: month 2026-11 is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: move the primary carboplatin contract from Accord to Teva and keep Accord as secondary. Rationale: Accord's supplier plant had an FDA warning letter; Teva supply steadier (demo history). Approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-1e26d5.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-91dde4.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('823b0010-2b57-4e76-b5ac-4a8c2963438f', 'cd99be87-c8d9-48d6-a8e5-e081052e3f19', 'f98314ea-a4e4-4f78-987b-3e9b45a08bb4', 'bdd048bb-7e6c-45c7-b51a-075e83ca9f5b') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-2e3278.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-8eaa41.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-09c871.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-baf492.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1810189', '3008461619', '3002807111') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-94d03c.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1810189', '3008461619', '3002807111') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-5b3cb1.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1810189') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('pharmacia upjohn', 'chartwell rx', 'sagent pharms')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-dddbca.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('pharmacia upjohn', 'chartwell rx', 'sagent pharms', 'sagent') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-296c7e.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00009027401', '00009075801', '25021082005', '62135076001')

Q-c45afb.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%'
